question: For each of the 328 supplied order-42 Ramsey cores, does any one-vertex extension have at most two monochromatic five-sets?

prior_exploration.observation: A complete 328-line Glucose screen found SAT only on catalog lines 42 and 256.
prior_exploration.evidentiary_status: Hypothesis only until every UNSAT line has an independently checked proof and every SAT model passes exhaustive graph checking.

encoding.primary_variables: 42 adjacency bits from the new vertex to the fixed core
encoding.relaxations: One definition-equivalent relaxation variable for every core homogeneous four-set extension constraint
encoding.bound: A deterministic forward counter enforces at most two true relaxation variables
encoding.semantics: SAT iff the fixed core has a one-vertex extension with at most two monochromatic five-sets

acceptance.formula: The independent checker must reconstruct every clause exactly, validate the core as K5-free and independent-5-free, and match all formula metadata and hashes.
acceptance.sat: The solver model must satisfy the CNF and an independent exhaustive enumeration of all 962598 five-subsets of the resulting 43-vertex graph must find at most two homogeneous sets.
acceptance.unsat: Glucose3 must emit DRAT and independently pinned drat-trim must print the exact status line s VERIFIED; all formula and proof hashes must remain stable.
acceptance.coverage: Exactly one accepted terminal record is required for each catalog line 1 through 328.

outcome_policy.expected_sat_lines_only: If and only if lines 42 and 256 are SAT and all other 326 lines are certified UNSAT, report that these are the unique E<=2-extensible supplied cores.
outcome_policy.unexpected_sat: Independently validate and report the model; do not preserve the exploratory two-line claim.
outcome_policy.timeout_or_failure: Make no complete-catalog claim and retain only individually verified line results.
outcome_policy.global_scope: No outcome proves a global order-43 Ramsey claim because the supplied 328 graphs are not a complete catalog of all order-42 Ramsey graphs.
